examples.en: Good friends communicate openly with each other.
examples.zh: 好朋友之間會坦誠地溝通。

examples.en: You can communicate with our office by email.
examples.zh: 你可以透過電子郵件與我們辦公室聯絡。

examples.en: Teachers must communicate the rules clearly to students.
examples.zh: 老師必須向學生清楚傳達規定。

examples.en: The comparison between the two phones helped me decide.
examples.zh: 兩支手機的比較幫助我做了決定。

examples.en: There is no comparison between the old and new designs.
examples.zh: 新舊設計根本無法相比。

examples.en: Her comparison of life to a journey was easy to understand.
examples.zh: 她把人生比作旅程的說法很容易理解。

examples.en: Many students compete for the same scholarship.
examples.zh: 許多學生競爭同一個獎學金。

examples.en: Our team will compete in the final match on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍星期六將參加決賽。

examples.en: Small shops find it hard to compete with big stores.
examples.zh: 小商店很難和大型商店競爭。

examples.en: We received a complaint about the noise last night.
examples.zh: 我們收到了關於昨晚噪音的投訴。

examples.en: She made a complaint to the hotel manager.
examples.zh: 她向飯店經理提出投訴。

examples.en: His only complaint is that the soup is too salty.
examples.zh: 他唯一的不滿是湯太鹹了。

examples.en: We bought two tickets for the concert next Friday.
examples.zh: 我們買了兩張下週五音樂會的票。

examples.en: The school choir will give a concert in the hall.
examples.zh: 學校合唱團將在禮堂舉辦音樂會。

examples.en: Thousands of fans came to the concert in the park.
examples.zh: 數千名歌迷來到公園參加演唱會。

examples.en: The scientist reached a clear conclusion after the test.
examples.zh: 科學家在實驗後得出了明確的結論。

examples.en: In conclusion, regular exercise is good for your health.
examples.zh: 總而言之，規律運動對健康有益。

examples.en: The conclusion of the movie surprised the audience.
examples.zh: 電影的結尾讓觀眾大吃一驚。

examples.en: The teacher drew a cone on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一個圓錐體。

examples.en: I'd like an ice cream cone with two scoops.
examples.zh: 我想要一支兩球的冰淇淋甜筒。

examples.en: Workers put an orange cone beside the hole in the road.
examples.zh: 工人在路上的坑洞旁放了一個橘色三角錐。

examples.en: Please connect the printer to your laptop.
examples.zh: 請把印表機連接到你的筆記型電腦。

examples.en: This bridge connects the island to the mainland.
examples.zh: 這座橋把小島和本土連接起來。

examples.en: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi in this room.
examples.zh: 我在這個房間無法連上無線網路。

senses.zh: 有意識的；意識到的；刻意的

examples.en: The patient was awake and fully conscious.
examples.zh: 病人醒著，意識完全清楚。

examples.en: I am conscious of the time, so I will be brief.
examples.zh: 我知道時間有限，所以會長話短說。

examples.en: She made a conscious effort to speak more slowly.
examples.zh: 她刻意努力讓自己說話慢一點。

senses.zh: 相當大的；可觀的；相當多的

examples.en: The new road saved us a considerable amount of time.
examples.zh: 新路為我們省下了相當多的時間。

examples.en: He spent a considerable sum on a used car.
examples.zh: 他花了一大筆錢買二手車。

examples.en: The storm caused considerable damage to the town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對小鎮造成了相當大的損害。

examples.en: The constant noise from the street kept me awake.
examples.zh: 街上持續不斷的噪音讓我睡不著。

examples.en: Keep the water at a constant temperature.
examples.zh: 請讓水溫保持恆定。

examples.en: She is my constant companion on every trip.
examples.zh: 她是我每趟旅行中不變的夥伴。

examples.en: In this formula, pi is a constant.
examples.zh: 在這個公式裡，圓周率是一個常數。

examples.en: Change is the only constant in life.
examples.zh: 變化是人生中唯一不變的事。

examples.en: The value of the constant stays the same in every test.
examples.zh: 這個常數的值在每次測驗中都不變。

examples.en: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
examples.zh: 亞洲是世界上最大的洲。

examples.en: Penguins live on the cold southern continent.
examples.zh: 企鵝生活在寒冷的南方大陸上。

examples.en: Which continent would you like to visit first?
examples.zh: 你最想先去哪一個洲旅行？

examples.en: My mother cooks rice in an electric rice cooker.
examples.zh: 我媽媽用電鍋煮飯。

examples.en: We bought a new gas cooker for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們為廚房買了一台新的瓦斯爐。

examples.en: This slow cooker makes soup while we are at work.
examples.zh: 這個慢燉鍋在我們上班時就把湯煮好了。

examples.en: Repairing the old car would be too costly.
examples.zh: 修理這輛舊車的花費太高了。

examples.en: A costly mistake can ruin a good plan.
examples.zh: 一個代價高昂的錯誤可能毀掉一個好計畫。

examples.en: Staying at that hotel is costly in the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天住那家飯店很貴。

examples.en: The baby fell asleep in the wooden cradle.
examples.zh: 寶寶在木製搖籃裡睡著了。

examples.en: Greece is often called the cradle of Western culture.
examples.zh: 希臘常被稱為西方文化的發源地。

examples.en: She gently rocked the cradle until it was quiet.
examples.zh: 她輕輕搖著搖籃，直到四周安靜下來。

examples.en: She cradled the sleeping kitten in her arms.
examples.zh: 她把熟睡的小貓輕輕抱在懷裡。

examples.en: He cradled the phone against his shoulder while typing.
examples.zh: 他一邊打字一邊用肩膀夾住電話。

examples.en: The nurse cradled the baby carefully.
examples.zh: 護理師小心地托抱著嬰兒。

examples.en: A white crane stood still beside the river.
examples.zh: 一隻白鶴靜靜地站在河邊。

examples.en: A tall crane lifted the steel beams onto the roof.
examples.zh: 一台高大的起重機把鋼樑吊到屋頂上。

examples.en: Paper cranes are a symbol of hope in Japan.
examples.zh: 紙鶴在日本是希望的象徵。

examples.en: There was a crash outside the store window.
examples.zh: 商店窗外傳來一聲巨響。

examples.en: Two cars were damaged in the crash on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速公路上的撞車事故讓兩輛車受損。

examples.en: The crash of my computer made me lose my homework.
examples.zh: 電腦當機讓我的作業不見了。

examples.en: The truck crashed into a wall near the school.
examples.zh: 卡車撞上了學校附近的一面牆。

examples.en: My laptop crashes whenever I open this program.
examples.zh: 我一打開這個程式，筆記型電腦就會當機。

examples.en: Waves crashed against the rocks all night.
examples.zh: 海浪整晚拍打著岩石。

examples.en: The baby can crawl across the living room now.
examples.zh: 寶寶現在可以爬過客廳了。

examples.en: Traffic crawled along the highway during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間車流在高速公路上緩慢爬行。

examples.en: A snail crawled slowly up the wall.
examples.zh: 一隻蝸牛慢慢爬上牆壁。

senses.zh: 爬行；蛙式以外的自由式

examples.en: The traffic slowed to a crawl near the tunnel.
examples.zh: 隧道附近的車流慢到幾乎爬行。

examples.en: He switched from the crawl to the backstroke.
examples.zh: 他從自由式換成了仰式。

examples.en: We moved at a crawl through the crowded market.
examples.zh: 我們在擁擠的市場裡慢慢前進。

examples.en: She is a creative girl who loves painting.
examples.zh: 她是個愛畫畫、很有創意的女孩。

examples.en: We need a creative way to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個有創意的方法來解決這個問題。

examples.en: The class gave students a creative writing task.
examples.zh: 這堂課讓學生做創意寫作的作業。

examples.en: The creator of the cartoon visited our school.
examples.zh: 這部卡通的創作者來到了我們學校。

examples.en: Each video creator has a different style.
examples.zh: 每位影片創作者都有自己的風格。

examples.en: Many people see the artist as the creator of this city's image.
examples.zh: 許多人認為這位藝術家是這座城市形象的締造者。

examples.en: The deep sea is home to many strange creatures.
examples.zh: 深海是許多奇特生物的家。

examples.en: A small furry creature ran across the path.
examples.zh: 一隻毛茸茸的小動物跑過小徑。

examples.en: The movie is about a friendly creature from space.
examples.zh: 這部電影是關於一個來自太空的友善生物。

examples.en: You can pay by credit at this shop.
examples.zh: 你可以在這家店用賒帳方式付款。

examples.en: I need three more credits to graduate.
examples.zh: 我還需要三個學分才能畢業。

examples.en: She deserves credit for organizing the whole event.
examples.zh: 她籌辦整場活動，值得讚揚。

examples.en: The bank credited the money to my account yesterday.
examples.zh: 銀行昨天已把這筆錢存入我的帳戶。

examples.en: They credited the team with the idea.
examples.zh: 他們把這個點子的功勞歸給了這個團隊。

examples.en: The shop will credit your card within five days.
examples.zh: 商店會在五天內把款項退回你的卡片。

senses.zh: 全體工作人員；機組人員；團隊

examples.en: The flight crew welcomed us on board.
examples.zh: 機組人員在登機時歡迎我們。

examples.en: A film crew is shooting a scene on our street.
examples.zh: 一個攝影團隊正在我們這條街上拍攝一場戲。

examples.en: The ship's crew worked together through the storm.
examples.zh: 船員們同心協力度過了暴風雨。

examples.en: Cricket is a popular sport in India and England.
examples.zh: 板球在印度和英國是很受歡迎的運動。

examples.en: We heard a cricket singing outside the window.
examples.zh: 我們聽到窗外有一隻蟋蟀在鳴叫。

examples.en: My uncle watches a cricket match every weekend.
examples.zh: 我叔叔每個週末都會看一場板球比賽。

examples.en: The police caught the criminal after a long search.
examples.zh: 警方經過長時間搜尋後逮捕了這名罪犯。

examples.en: A young criminal was sent to a special school.
examples.zh: 一名年輕罪犯被送去特別的學校。

examples.en: The movie tells the story of a famous criminal.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一名著名罪犯的故事。

examples.en: He has no criminal record.
examples.zh: 他沒有犯罪紀錄。

examples.en: Stealing is a criminal act.
examples.zh: 偷竊是犯罪行為。

examples.en: The lawyer works on criminal cases.
examples.zh: 這位律師處理刑事案件。

examples.en: I love the crispy skin on fried chicken.
examples.zh: 我喜歡炸雞酥脆的外皮。

examples.en: These crispy potato chips are my favorite snack.
examples.zh: 這些香脆的洋芋片是我最愛的零食。

examples.en: The toast should be warm and crispy.
examples.zh: 吐司應該又熱又酥脆。

examples.en: Rice is the main crop in this region.
examples.zh: 稻米是這個地區的主要農作物。

examples.en: Heavy rain destroyed most of the crop this year.
examples.zh: 今年大雨毀掉了大部分的收成。

examples.en: Farmers planted a new crop of corn in spring.
examples.zh: 農夫在春天種下了新一批玉米。

examples.en: Please crop the photo to remove the edges.
examples.zh: 請把照片裁剪掉邊緣。

examples.en: He cropped the picture to fit the frame.
examples.zh: 他把圖片剪裁成適合相框的大小。

examples.en: The gardener cropped the grass very short.
examples.zh: 園丁把草剪得很短。

examples.en: The queen wore a gold crown at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 女王在典禮上戴著一頂金色王冠。

examples.en: The crown of the hat was covered in flowers.
examples.zh: 帽子的頂部覆滿了花朵。

examples.en: Our team won the national crown last year.
examples.zh: 我們隊伍去年贏得了全國冠軍頭銜。

examples.en: The plates are in the cupboard above the sink.
examples.zh: 盤子放在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: My mother keeps rice and noodles in the kitchen cupboard.
examples.zh: 我媽媽把米和麵條放在廚房櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: He hid the cookies at the back of the cupboard.
examples.zh: 他把餅乾藏在櫥櫃的最裡面。

examples.en: Milk and cheese are dairy products.
examples.zh: 牛奶和起司都是乳製品。

examples.en: The dairy delivers fresh milk every morning.
examples.zh: 乳品店每天早上送來新鮮牛奶。

examples.en: We visited a dairy and saw the cows being milked.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一座酪農場，看到乳牛被擠奶。

examples.en: I can't eat dairy food because of my allergy.
examples.zh: 我因為過敏不能吃乳製食品。

examples.en: She works on a dairy farm in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她在鄉下的酪農場工作。

examples.en: Dairy cows need a lot of fresh water.
examples.zh: 乳牛需要大量乾淨的水。

examples.en: The dam provides water and power for the city.
examples.zh: 這座水壩為城市提供水和電力。

examples.en: Visitors can walk across the top of the dam.
examples.zh: 遊客可以走過水壩的頂部。

examples.en: Beavers built a small dam across the stream.
examples.zh: 河狸在小溪上築了一座小水壩。

examples.en: I wouldn't dare to speak to the principal like that.
examples.zh: 我不敢那樣對校長說話。

examples.en: Nobody dared to open the old door.
examples.zh: 沒有人敢打開那扇舊門。

examples.en: My friend dared me to try the spicy noodles.
examples.zh: 我的朋友激我試試那碗辣麵。

examples.en: He jumped into the cold pool on a dare.
examples.zh: 他因為被挑戰而跳進冰冷的游泳池。

examples.en: It was a dare, but she didn't take it.
examples.zh: 那是一個挑戰，但她沒有接受。

examples.en: Truth or dare is a popular party game.
examples.zh: 真心話大冒險是很受歡迎的派對遊戲。

examples.en: Thank you, darling, for the lovely card.
examples.zh: 謝謝你，親愛的，這張卡片真可愛。

examples.en: The baby is the darling of the whole family.
examples.zh: 這個寶寶是全家的寶貝。

examples.en: Come here, darling, and meet my friend.
examples.zh: 過來，寶貝，來認識我的朋友。

examples.en: My darling daughter just turned ten.
examples.zh: 我親愛的女兒剛滿十歲。

examples.en: She wore a darling little hat to the picnic.
examples.zh: 她戴了一頂可愛的小帽子去野餐。

examples.en: What a darling puppy you have!
examples.zh: 你的小狗好可愛啊！

examples.en: I have to dash to catch the last bus.
examples.zh: 我得趕快衝去搭末班公車。

examples.en: The children dashed out of the classroom at noon.
examples.zh: 孩子們中午衝出了教室。

examples.en: She dashed to the store before it closed.
examples.zh: 她在商店打烊前匆忙地跑了過去。

examples.en: He won the hundred-meter dash at school.
examples.zh: 他在學校贏得了一百公尺短跑。

examples.en: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
examples.zh: 在湯裡加一點點鹽。

examples.en: Use a dash to show a short pause in your sentence.
examples.zh: 用破折號來表示句子中的短暫停頓。

examples.en: The town has changed a lot in the past decade.
examples.zh: 小鎮在過去十年變化很大。

examples.en: She has worked at this company for over a decade.
examples.zh: 她在這家公司工作超過十年了。

examples.en: The first decade of the century was full of change.
examples.zh: 本世紀的第一個十年充滿了變化。

examples.en: Passengers walked along the deck to watch the sunset.
examples.zh: 乘客沿著甲板散步看夕陽。

examples.en: We had dinner on the wooden deck behind the house.
examples.zh: 我們在屋後的木平台上吃晚餐。

examples.en: Can you shuffle this deck of cards for us?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我們洗這副牌嗎？

examples.en: Helping the old man was a kind deed.
examples.zh: 幫助那位老先生是一件善行。

examples.en: The mayor was praised for his brave deeds.
examples.zh: 市長因勇敢的事蹟而受到讚揚。

examples.en: They signed the deed to the house yesterday.
examples.zh: 他們昨天簽署了這棟房子的所有權契約。

examples.en: Please look up the definition of this word in the dictionary.
examples.zh: 請在字典裡查這個字的定義。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write our own definition of honesty.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫出自己對誠實的定義。

examples.en: The new screen has excellent picture definition.
examples.zh: 這個新螢幕的畫面清晰度非常好。

examples.en: I made a deposit at the bank this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上去銀行存了款。

examples.en: You need to pay a deposit to book the room.
examples.zh: 你需要付訂金才能預訂房間。

examples.en: The landlord returned my deposit after I moved out.
examples.zh: 房東在我搬走後退還了押金。

examples.en: She deposited her salary into a savings account.
examples.zh: 她把薪水存入儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Please deposit your coins in the machine.
examples.zh: 請把你的硬幣投入機器。

examples.en: He deposited the bag on the table.
examples.zh: 他把袋子放在桌上。

examples.en: The designer showed us a new set of clothes.
examples.zh: 設計師向我們展示了一系列新衣服。

examples.en: My sister wants to be a web designer.
examples.zh: 我姊姊想成為網頁設計師。

examples.en: The room was decorated by a famous designer.
examples.zh: 這個房間是由一位著名的設計師佈置的。

senses.zh: 值得想要的；理想的；吸引人的

examples.en: A quiet street is a desirable place to live.
examples.zh: 安靜的街道是理想的居住地點。

examples.en: Good computer skills are desirable for this job.
examples.zh: 具備良好的電腦技能對這份工作是有利的。

examples.en: The house has a desirable location near the station.
examples.zh: 這棟房子位置理想，就在車站附近。

examples.en: A strong typhoon can destroy many old houses.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風可能毀壞許多老房子。

examples.en: Please destroy these old files before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請銷毀這些舊檔案。

examples.en: Pollution can destroy the homes of sea animals.
examples.zh: 汙染會破壞海洋動物的棲息地。

examples.en: In the story, the devil asked for his soul.
examples.zh: 在故事裡，魔鬼要求他的靈魂。

examples.en: The little devil in the cartoon wore red clothes.
examples.zh: 卡通裡的小惡魔穿著紅色衣服。

examples.en: He is a lucky devil who always wins the game.
examples.zh: 他是個走運的傢伙，總是贏得比賽。

examples.en: The room was too dim for us to read.
examples.zh: 房間太昏暗，我們沒辦法閱讀。

examples.en: A dim light shone from the old window.
examples.zh: 一道微弱的光從舊窗戶透出來。

examples.en: I have only a dim memory of that trip.
examples.zh: 我對那趟旅行只有模糊的記憶。

examples.en: Please dim the lights before the movie starts.
examples.zh: 電影開始前請把燈調暗。

examples.en: The clouds dimmed the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 雲層使午後的陽光變暗了。

examples.en: The screen will dim to save power.
examples.zh: 螢幕會變暗以節省電力。

examples.en: A dime is worth ten cents in the United States.
examples.zh: 在美國，一個十分錢硬幣價值十美分。

examples.en: He found a dime on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 他在人行道上撿到一枚十分錢硬幣。

examples.en: I need a dime to use the old machine.
examples.zh: 我需要一枚十分錢硬幣來使用這台舊機器。

examples.en: We usually dine together on Sunday evenings.
examples.zh: 我們通常在週日晚上一起用餐。

examples.en: They plan to dine at a Japanese restaurant tonight.
examples.zh: 他們打算今晚在一家日本餐廳用餐。

examples.en: Guests will dine in the garden if the weather is nice.
examples.zh: 如果天氣好，客人們會在花園裡用餐。

examples.en: I like to dip fries in ketchup.
examples.zh: 我喜歡把薯條蘸番茄醬。

examples.en: She dipped her toes in the cool water.
examples.zh: 她把腳趾浸入涼涼的水裡。

examples.en: Prices tend to dip after the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期過後價格往往會下降。

examples.en: The party table had chips and a creamy dip.
examples.zh: 派對的桌上有洋芋片和濃稠的蘸醬。

examples.en: Let's take a quick dip in the pool.
examples.zh: 我們去泳池裡快速泡一下水吧。

examples.en: There was a small dip in sales last month.
examples.zh: 上個月銷售額略有下降。

examples.en: The children played in the dirt behind the house.
examples.zh: 孩子們在屋後的泥土裡玩耍。

examples.en: Wash the dirt off your hands before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐前先把手上的汙垢洗掉。

examples.en: A dirt road leads to the small village.
examples.zh: 一條泥土路通往那個小村莊。

examples.en: This store gives students a ten percent discount.
examples.zh: 這家店給學生九折優惠。

examples.en: I got a big discount on the shoes.
examples.zh: 我買這雙鞋拿到很大的折扣。

examples.en: Is there a discount for buying two tickets?
examples.zh: 買兩張票有折扣嗎？

examples.en: The shop discounted all winter coats by half.
examples.zh: 商店把所有冬季外套減價一半。

examples.en: They discount old items at the end of the season.
examples.zh: 他們在季末把舊商品打折。

examples.en: Airlines often discount tickets in the off season.
examples.zh: 航空公司常在淡季為機票減價。

examples.en: Save the file on the hard disk before you shut down.
examples.zh: 關機前請把檔案存到硬碟裡。

examples.en: The disk is full, so I can't add more photos.
examples.zh: 磁碟滿了，所以我沒辦法再加照片。

examples.en: A flat disk spun slowly on the table.
examples.zh: 一個扁平的圓盤在桌上慢慢旋轉。
